braces.effect: +20% critical chance — the go-to brace for damage builds
braces.name: Certus

combos.name: Raplak / Propa / Certus
combos.why: The classic Eidolon DPS amp. Accurate Raplak primary for limbs, Propa mines for burst, Certus crit — still the community standard for hunts.

combos.name: Klamora / Propa / Certus
combos.why: Wide-angle Klamora clears groups, Propa handles burst. A strong all-rounder that works everywhere including Steel Path content.

combos.name: Cantic / Propa / Certus
combos.why: Fast, ammo-efficient Cantic primary with the Propa/Certus punch. Great if you hate managing the amp energy bar.

combos.name: Klamora / Phahd / Certus
combos.why: Bouncing Phahd projectiles clear rooms of weaker enemies. Fun and effective for open-world bounties.

howToBuild: Buy part blueprints from the Quills (Cetus, tiers 1-4) or Little Duck / Vox Solaris (Fortuna, tiers 5-7) with standing. Craft the parts in the foundry, assemble at the vendor, level the amp to 30, then GILD it to unlock its true stats. Only gilded prisms give mastery.

steelPathNote: For Steel Path and Eidolons, crit is king: pair a high-crit prism (Raplak, Klamora) with the Propa scaffold and Certus brace. Gilding is mandatory — an ungilded amp does a fraction of its real damage.
